name: BUILD-RETRY-texture-failure-kept
note: One failed read of an archive is its answer for the page: every later pixel that wears it throws.

name: BUILD-RETRY-people-failure-kept
note: One failed person picture fails every populated pixel's build for the session.

name: BUILD-RETRY-store-close-unheard
note: A connection the browser closed is handed out again: every door of the store but the game data's guarded read fails on it.

name: BUILD-RETRY-store-closing-read-not-asked-again
note: A read that meets a closing connection falls through to the server, which on the deployed site has no game data.

name: BUILD-RETRY-stream-never-asks
note: A failed pixel waits for the next crossing that lists it - a hole in the grid until then.

name: BUILD-RETRY-stream-asks-at-once
old: this.failed.set(key, { px, py, tries, at: tries <= BUILD_RETRY_MS.length ? now + BUILD_RETRY_MS[tries - 1] : Infinity });
new: this.failed.set(key, { px, py, tries, at: tries <= BUILD_RETRY_MS.length ? now : Infinity });
note: No wait: a failing pixel is rebuilt back to back, five times in as many frames.

name: BUILD-RETRY-stream-unbounded
old: this.failed.set(key, { px, py, tries, at: tries <= BUILD_RETRY_MS.length ? now + BUILD_RETRY_MS[tries - 1] : Infinity });
new: this.failed.set(key, { px, py, tries, at: now + BUILD_RETRY_MS[0] });
note: A pixel that cannot be built is asked for every two seconds for as long as it stands in the grid.

name: BUILD-RETRY-stream-out-of-grid
note: A pixel the traveller left behind is built again where nobody stands, and never let go.

name: BUILD-RETRY-host-pump-releases
note: The pump lets a failed pixel go as it did: nothing but a crossing asks for it again.

name: BUILD-RETRY-host-frame-unasked
note: The stream's wait runs out and nothing asks the queue for the pixel.

name: BUILD-RETRY-host-stood-unheard
note: A pixel that stood keeps its failures: its next failure waits as if it had failed every time.
